sinopsis.es: Este caleidoscópico sabotaje cultural del visionario Matthew Rankin (The Twentieth Century, Universal Language) recorre el ascenso del decimoctavo primer ministro de Canadá mediante un collage satírico de material de archivo, nostalgia televisiva y construcción del mito nacional.
sinopsis.en: This kaleidoscopic culture jam from visionary filmmaker Matthew Rankin (The Twentieth Century, Universal Language) details the rise of Canada’s 18th prime minister through a satirical collage of archival footage, television nostalgia, and national mythmaking.
